XCUIElementTypeStaticText.value: Water absorbs red light first, then orange and yellow, so underwater photos and videos come out blue or green. Reefhue measures the water colour in each photo, or in every frame of a video, and brings those colours back automatically. Sliders let you fine-tune the result.
